thread.title: Raymond James Keeps a Buy Rating on Blackline Safety (BLN)

author: Austin Angelo
title: Raymond James Keeps a Buy Rating on Blackline Safety (BLN)
text:
Blackline Safety ( BLN – Research Report ), the Consumer Goods sector company, was revisited by a Wall Street analyst today. The company received a Buy rating from Raymond James’ analyst Ben Cherniavsky , with a C$6 price target.
Cherniavsky has an average return of 3.4% when recommending Blackline Safety.
According to TipRanks.com , Cherniavsky is ranked #1187 out of 5095 analysts.
Read also: China, iPhone Fears Worries Analyst on Apple (AAPL) Stock
Blackline Safety has an analyst consensus of Moderate Buy, with a price target consensus of C$6.
Based on Blackline Safety’s latest earnings release for the quarter ending July 31, the company reported a quarterly GAAP net loss of C$2.05 million. In comparison, last year the company had a GAAP net loss of C$2.68 million.
Blackline Safety Corp. engages in developing, manufacturing, and marketing products and services for employee monitoring. It operates through the Product and Service segments. The Product segment consists of sales from connected safety monitoring hardware devices to a variety of industries and geographic locations.
The company’s shares closed on Thursday at C$5.15.
